title: Phase 1 (Foundation): upload-path bug fixes + analysis pipeline deployed and verified
description:
Make the existing record→upload→analyze path reliable and actually running before building any UI on top of it.

Scope: the 6 open upload bugs (re-parented under this issue: jits-1v6, jits-81l, jits-hu0, jits-voh, jits-0lc, jits-za8), pipeline deployment/verification (slicer Cloud Run deploy + GUC wiring + bucket-in-migration), and the WebM-vs-MP4 decision for web recordings. Related: jits-a8y.13 (clip silently dropped if End fires before recorder reaches recording) stays under epic jits-a8y but is dep-linked here; fix it with this cluster.

Repos: jits_web (apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts, apps/mobile/lib/video/*, packages/shared/src/api/mutations.ts) + jr_be (workers/video-slicer, supabase/migrations, config.toml).
acceptance_criteria: All child/dep-linked bugs closed. A real mobile recording uploads (including the retry path), produces a match_videos row, and progresses ready→slicing→analyzing→merging→analyzed end-to-end against the deployed slicer. WebM decision recorded and its follow-up filed.

title: Mobile sign-in always redirects already-active athlete to /profile-setup (isLoading race)
description:
SYMPTOM: signing into the native app (Google SSO and email/password) always routes an already-active athlete to /profile-setup, which then renders in 'Edit Profile' mode with their info pre-filled. Confirmed on remote (prod rzowigdcdojlovlwwpkx) account matthew.spon@gmail.com: athletes row status=active, all fields populated. So backend data + triggers are correct; this is purely frontend.

ROOT CAUSE: apps/mobile/lib/auth/auth-context.tsx onAuthStateChange set isLoading=false in the no-user branch but never re-armed isLoading=true on a fresh sign-in. After sitting on the login screen (isLoading already false from INITIAL_SESSION no-user, athlete null), an explicit sign-in set user but left isLoading=false + athlete=null. login.tsx then router.replace('/'), and app/index.tsx ran 'if (!athlete) redirect(/profile-setup)' synchronously, before the async getCurrentAthlete resolved. Synchronous redirect beats async fetch every time -> happens on every sign-in, deterministically. Cold-start with a restored session was unaffected (INITIAL_SESSION arrives WITH a user; isLoading stays true until load).

FIX: re-arm isLoading=true (synchronously, in the same render that sets the user) when a sign-in is for a user whose athlete row has not been loaded yet, tracked via a loadedAthleteForUserId ref. Token refreshes / repeat events for the same user do not re-arm (no Loading flash). Decision extracted to pure apps/mobile/lib/auth/athlete-load.ts (needsAthleteLoad). The callback stays synchronous (auth processLock hard rule respected).

TESTS: apps/mobile/__tests__/lib/auth/athlete-load.test.ts (pure helper + full state-machine simulation of the sign-in race, pending-athlete path, token refresh, account switch).

VERIFICATION: typecheck all workspaces clean; full suite green (mobile 285, web 39, shared 188); independent agent review APPROVE (no correctness issues). No native module / app.json / metro change, so no expo export gate needed.
close_reason: Implemented + independently reviewed (APPROVE) + quality gate green (typecheck all workspaces, tests mobile 285/web 39/shared 188). Pending commit on branch feat/splash-glow-statement.

title: Mobile match flow: end_match completes match before record_match_result, breaking result + ELO
description:
REPRODUCED via headless two-account harness (Demo Blue vs Demo Red, real RPCs through RLS).

Mobile session match flow: live-step 'End Match' calls end_match (use-live-controls.ts:32) which sets matches.status='completed'. The result step then calls record_match_result, which REQUIRES status='in_progress' and raises invalid_status ('Match is not in progress'). Result: match ends completed with result=null and NO ELO applied (both athletes Δ0). Secondary bug: getCurrentStep maps completed->summary, so a reload skips result/confirm.

Control proof: start->record (no end_match) works: applies ELO (Blue +14 / Red -14), result=submission. The web/challenge flow already uses start->record (never calls end_match), so that's the canonical design.

FIX (mobile-only, no backend migration): handleEnd should stop the local timer, broadcast match-ended to the opponent, and advance to the result step WITHOUT calling end_match. record_match_result then completes the match; the trg_release_session_participants trigger still releases participants on the in_progress->completed transition.

Acceptance: harness scenario A (end-before-record path) must record + apply ELO end-to-end; both athletes confirm; match completes with result=submission and non-zero symmetric ELO delta. typecheck + mobile jest green.
close_reason: Fixed in apps/mobile/lib/match-flow/use-live-controls.ts: handleEnd no longer calls end_match; record_match_result now completes the match + applies ELO. Independently reviewed (APPROVE-WITH-NITS, nits addressed). Verified end-to-end via headless two-account harness across challenge + random matchmaking, submission + draw. Quality gate green: full typecheck + mobile 204 tests.

title: Online presence broken: per-mount channel name breaks Supabase sync
description: apps/mobile/lib/presence/use-online-presence.ts:101 subscribes to 'app:online:${mountId}' (unique topic per mount) while web/test-harness/its own doc use the shared 'app:online' topic. Presence only syncs members of the same topic, so onlineIds only ever contains self and the athlete never appears in web's set. Fix: subscribe to constant 'app:online' with presence key=athleteId; keep mountId only as a stale-write guard, not in the topic name.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile and web share the 'app:online' topic; an athlete online on one platform appears in the other's onlineIds; mountId retained only as stale-write guard.
close_reason: Closed

title: Concierge-seed the launch gym's roster and a live session (cold-start)
description:
PROBLEM: The funnel's ENDPOINT does not exist for a solo new user: the first match depends on a gym manager seeding a live session, and Gyms/Rankings are empty until seeding happens. The strongest, most consistent research finding (atomic-network / gym-by-gym saturation) is that a new athlete must open into a populated LOCAL roster, not a national leaderboard of 6. This is the actual launch-readiness blocker and outranks most client polish for real retention; it is under-weighted because it is ops/data, not code.

EVIDENCE: Recon: 'No real first value is reachable in-app by a new user's own action'; ordinary users cannot create sessions (gym-manager gated, gyms/[id].tsx:175,239); research: saturate ONE gym first, atomic networks (https://uxcam.com/blog/10-apps-with-great-user-onboarding/ ; Andrew Chen atomic network)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Process + data, NOT a schema change. Using the existing gym_managers / is_gym_manager seeding (service-role), onboard the launch gym's full roster and seed at least one live/upcoming session so a new athlete in that city opens into real local opponents and a joinable session. Manually seed the first ~50 athletes via concierge outreach. Add a verified-gym badge as the anti-ghost-town trust signal for the skeptical BJJ audience. This is the precondition that makes the aha reachable; the Home 'Find your first match' CTA and the Gyms tab are dead ends without it.

AFFECTED: jr_be/supabase/ (seed scripts, service-role), no app code change required for the seeding itself

Group: BiggerBet | Effort L | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #11).
acceptance_criteria: A test athlete created in the launch city sees a populated local gym roster, not an empty list ; At least one joinable live/upcoming session exists at the launch gym ; The launch gym shows a verified-gym indicator ; The Home 'Find your first match' CTA leads to a real session a user can actually join ; Seeding uses service-role + existing gym_managers infra, no schema migration

title: Instrument the activation funnel end-to-end (analytics layer)
description:
PROBLEM: There is NO product analytics in the repo (only Sentry error tracking). The field-cliff, the aha threshold, and every 'High impact' claim in this roadmap are currently UNMEASURABLE. Pre-launch is the only time to instrument TestFlight cohorts; you cannot retro-measure them. This is the single highest-leverage missing item across all four expert lenses.

EVIDENCE: lib/error-tracking/sentry.ts is the only telemetry; no analytics SDK in package.json; research: the only way to confirm the cliff and define aha is your own funnel analytics (https://www.lennysnewsletter.com/p/how-to-determine-your-activation ; https://amplitude.com/blog/aha-moment)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Add a lightweight cross-platform analytics module under @jits/shared (so web and mobile share event names) and emit the ladder: signup_started, signup_submitted (with method: email|google), wizard_step_viewed{tos,identity,training}, athlete_activated, push_primer_shown/accepted/declined, first_session_joined, first_match_result (the aha). Choose a privacy-respecting SDK; adding a native analytics SDK may need a new EAS build (verify, flag as build-gated). Wire the activation event off the existing status re-read in use-setup-submit.ts:112-121. Then run a retention-correlation analysis once data exists to confirm/replace the assumed aha.

AFFECTED: packages/shared/src/analytics/ (new), apps/mobile/lib/profile-setup/use-setup-submit.ts, apps/mobile/app/(auth)/signup.tsx, apps/web/app/(auth)/ (signup/eua)

Group: BiggerBet | Effort M | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #10).
acceptance_criteria: Every funnel event in the ladder fires with correct properties on both platforms (or mobile-first if web is descoped) ; athlete_activated fires exactly once per activation, off the verified status flip ; No PII beyond what privacy policy permits is sent ; A dashboard/query can compute activation rate = signups reaching athlete_activated within the window ; If a native SDK is required, the new-EAS-build dependency is documented

title: Give zero-state Home one Signal-Red primary CTA and branch the free-agent plate copy
description:
PROBLEM: A freshly-activated user lands on an all-empty Home whose single forward action is a low-emphasis mono 'Find a session ->' link inside a dashed box, leaving the brand's one-primary-CTA slot unused for the new-user goal. Worse, the no-session accent plate is rendered UNCONDITIONALLY, so a free agent (who has no gym) is told 'Your gym hasn't designated a live session yet', which is incoherent and signals the app does not know their state. Web already branches this on primary_gym_id; mobile did not.

EVIDENCE: home/index.tsx:176-181 (unconditional 'Your gym hasn't designated a live session' Plate, no primary_gym_id branch); recent-activity-section.tsx (low-emphasis 'Find a session' link); web apps/web/app/(app)/page.tsx:331-333 branches on primary_gym_id; CLAUDE.md one-primary-CTA-per-surface rule

PROPOSED CHANGE: Client-only UI. (1) When the user has 0 matches and no live session, render ONE full-width Signal-Red primary CtaButton near the top of Home: 'Find your first match' -> routes to /(app)/gyms. This is the surface's single primary CTA; demote the existing buried link to the populated state only. (2) Branch the plate copy on athlete.primary_gym_id exactly like web: gym-having user keeps 'Your gym hasn't scheduled a session yet'; free agent gets 'You're competing as a free agent. Browse partner gyms near you to find an open mat or live session.' Keep the ELO tile narrative as 'Your starting rating'; do NOT turn any numeric value red. Static only, no confetti. CRITICAL: this CTA points at the Gyms tab, so it MUST ship in the same release as the Gyms empty-state fix or it routes users to a dead end.

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/(home)/index.tsx, apps/mobile/components/home/recent-activity-section.tsx

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact Medium. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #3).
acceptance_criteria: Zero-state Home shows exactly one Signal-Red primary CTA routing to /(app)/gyms; no second red CTA competes ; The no-session plate copy differs for free agents (no 'your gym' language) vs gym-having users, matching web's branch ; The primary CTA disappears (replaced by the existing populated-state UI) once the athlete has >=1 match, with no flicker during the stats fetch ; No numeric value (ELO, W/L/D) is rendered in Signal Red

title: Reframe the zero-match profile: kill '0%' win rate and anchor the bare ELO 1000 as provisional
description:
PROBLEM: A new jiu-jiteiro sees a '0%' win rate (reads as 'loses every match', not 'new') and a context-free ELO 1000 (1000 of what? good? bad?). In BJJ culture you EARN standing by showing up; branding someone a 0% loser on day one is culturally backwards and de-motivates exactly the competitive user the app wants. The empty/dead-looking profile is the documented #1 first-run risk for a rating app.

EVIDENCE: profile-quick-stats.tsx:62,65 (renders '0%' for null/zero winRate); athlete/competitor-header.tsx:32 (also '0%' when total===0); research: empty profile is the #1 rating-app first-run risk, anchor the number as a starting line (https://uxcam.com/blog/10-apps-with-great-user-onboarding/ ; growth.design/psychology)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Client-only formatting of data already on screen (totalMatches, current_elo). (1) When totalMatches===0 render Win Rate as the word 'New' (NOT '0%', NOT an em-dash which is brand-banned); apply to BOTH profile-quick-stats.tsx AND competitor-header.tsx AND any Home StatOverview so '0' does not leak elsewhere. (2) On the Home EloTile add a small MetaTag 'PROVISIONAL, Unranked until your first ranked match' beneath the 1000. (3) Add one anchoring line near the ELO: '1000 is everyone's starting rating. Win ranked matches to climb.' Keep the ELO number in JetBrains Mono default foreground, NEVER red. Do NOT imply belts map to ELO (belts are earned on the mat).

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/components/profile/profile-quick-stats.tsx, apps/mobile/components/athlete/competitor-header.tsx, apps/mobile/components/ui/elo-system/elo-tile.tsx, apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/(home)/index.tsx

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #2).
acceptance_criteria: A zero-match athlete sees 'New' (or equivalent) for win rate, never '0%', on every surface (own profile, competitor header, home stats) ; Home EloTile shows a PROVISIONAL tag and one anchoring sentence when totalMatches===0 ; The ELO numeric value remains JetBrains Mono tabular-nums and is never rendered in Signal Red ; Copy makes no claim that ELO maps to or assigns a belt rank ; Once the athlete has >=1 match, the real win-rate percentage and no PROVISIONAL tag render

title: Gate the cold push prompt behind a branded in-context primer
description:
PROBLEM: The iOS push permission dialog fires automatically the instant the athlete row activates and Home mounts, with zero context. iOS gives exactly ONE native prompt per permission, so a cold ask at the worst possible moment (brand-new user, zero matches, no reason to say yes) buys a PERMANENT per-device deny, after which challenge/match alerts silently never arrive. This is the single highest-confidence fix in the panel: the call site is trivially gateable and expo-notifications is already in the binary.

EVIDENCE: register-push.ts:44-48 (ensurePermission calls Notifications.requestPermissionsAsync cold); push-registration-bootstrap.tsx:23-38 (effect keyed on athleteId fires registration on activation); research: iOS push is opt-in and one-shot (https://www.nngroup.com/articles/permission-requests/ ; https://www.appcues.com/blog/mobile-permission-priming)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Stop auto-firing requestPermissionsAsync on activation. Split registration into (a) push-TOKEN registration that runs when permission is ALREADY granted (getPermissionsAsync === granted, no prompt), and (b) the native prompt, which fires only from the affirmative CTA of a branded primer Plate (dark, sharp corners, no motion). Persist a 'push_primer_shown' flag in AsyncStorage. CRITICAL per critique: do NOT tie the primer to a value moment the cold-start product cannot deliver (first challenge/first session may never happen for TestFlight users). Trigger the primer on a reachable moment: entering the Gyms tab for the first time, or second app open. Copy: 'Get notified the moment someone challenges you or your match is confirmed.' Do NOT add iOS provisional authorization here, that is a build-gated item (see separate BiggerBet).

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/lib/notifications/register-push.ts, apps/mobile/lib/notifications/push-registration-bootstrap.tsx, apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/gyms/index.tsx, apps/mobile/components/ui/elo-system/ (new primer Plate)

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #1).
acceptance_criteria: No OS push dialog appears on first Home mount after activation (verified on a fresh device/simulator) ; Push token still registers automatically when permission was already granted, with no prompt ; The branded primer appears once at a reachable trigger (Gyms tab entry or 2nd app open) and only fires the native prompt on its affirmative CTA ; AsyncStorage primer-shown flag prevents the primer reappearing ; Declining the primer leaves the app fully usable and does not re-nag

title: TestFlight launch crash: monorepo root package.json poisons RN/Hermes ABI (RN 0.82 vs 0.81.4)
description: Root package.json (commit 2538fd9) replaced the workspace scripts+husky with an erroneous, duplicated react-native* dependency block: react-native 0.82.0, react-native-worklets ^0.6.0, react-native-reanimated ^4.1.3, react-native-svg, react-native-web. These hoist to root node_modules and conflict with apps/mobile's SDK 54 pins (RN 0.81.4 / worklets 0.5.1 / reanimated ~4.1.1). npm ls reports react-native 0.81.4 'deduped invalid: 0.82.0'. The mixed RN/Hermes JSI ABI corrupts the Hermes heap at launch. All 4 TestFlight crash logs (builds 2 & 3) are Hermes heap corruption (HadesGC oldGenCollectionWorker tripwire abort, DictPropertyMap::findOrAdd, HiddenClass::findProperty, shared_ptr release) with garbage fault addresses and NO Last Exception Backtrace -- i.e. memory corruption, not an uncaught JS/env exception. Side effects of the same bad edit: root lost scripts (typecheck/test/build:web/db:types) and husky devDep, so the pre-commit gate silently stopped running. apps/mobile/package.json and root package.json both have duplicate keys (botched merge). Fix: restore root package.json to known-good initial version (8d57e85: scripts+husky, no RN deps); dedupe apps/mobile keys; reinstall; verify single RN 0.81.4 tree + expo install --check + expo export.
close_reason: Closed

title: Web in-session challenge accept fails: accepter passed as timekeeper
description: apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172 calls createInSessionMatch with timekeeperId: currentAthleteId (the accepter, who is also a competitor in the match). Same RPC validation as jits-9l4 rejects this with 'Timekeeper cannot be a competitor in the match'. Result: web user clicks Accept on an incoming challenge and silently sees nothing happen (the broadcast challenge_accepted is never sent because the mutation fails first). The original c0b985e fix was meant to enable the timekeeper-live recorder step on web; that step gates on match.timekeeper_id === athlete.id, so dropping the timekeeper id reverts to fighter-live (no recorder). Two viable fixes: (1) drop the timekeeperId assignment and run the recorder on both fighter devices like mobile does, (2) change the BE RPC to allow caller-as-timekeeper. Option 1 is symmetric with the mobile fix and unblocks the demo without a migration. Affects 013 video flow.
close_reason: Verified fixed on development branch (2026-05-26 audit). jits-zyq + jits-9l4: createInSessionMatch in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172 and apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:80-82 both omit timekeeperId now (caller is no longer passed as timekeeper). jits-y91: all 4 router.* navigation calls in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts use router.push (lines 86, 110, 122, 176), not router.replace. jits-e0w: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/confirm-step.tsx wires useMatchCompletion (postgres_changes on matches row) + a myConfirmed && opponentConfirmed effect; auto-advance works for DB-side confirms. jits-65p: both apps/web/app/(app)/match/[id]/results/submission-fields.tsx:70 and apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/submission-fields.tsx:52 label finish_time as '(optional)' correctly.

title: In-session challenge fails: caller-as-timekeeper rejected by RPC
description: Mobile lobby (apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:75) and web realtime hook (apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172) pass the calling athlete as timekeeperId to createInSessionMatch. The BE RPC create_session_match (jr_be/supabase/migrations/20260501000000_session_matches_ranked.sql:88-92) explicitly rejects timekeeper_id matching either competitor with 'Timekeeper cannot be a competitor in the match' (HINT invalid_timekeeper). Result: every in-session challenge currently fails with a toast and no match is created. Introduced in c0b985e while trying to enable the 013 video flow on web. Mobile recording is per-device (uploaderAthleteId=me.athlete_id in live-step.tsx) and never needed timekeeper to be set, so removing the assignment on mobile is the right fix. Web's fighter-live vs timekeeper-live routing needs a different approach (e.g. recorder always-on for both fighters, or BE RPC change to allow caller-as-timekeeper). Affects the 013 demo.
close_reason: Verified fixed on development branch (2026-05-26 audit). jits-zyq + jits-9l4: createInSessionMatch in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172 and apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:80-82 both omit timekeeperId now (caller is no longer passed as timekeeper). jits-y91: all 4 router.* navigation calls in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts use router.push (lines 86, 110, 122, 176), not router.replace. jits-e0w: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/confirm-step.tsx wires useMatchCompletion (postgres_changes on matches row) + a myConfirmed && opponentConfirmed effect; auto-advance works for DB-side confirms. jits-65p: both apps/web/app/(app)/match/[id]/results/submission-fields.tsx:70 and apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/submission-fields.tsx:52 label finish_time as '(optional)' correctly.

title: Mobile video upload retry generates new filename; double-orphan path
description: apps/mobile/lib/video/use-video-recorder.ts:88-101 retries entire uploadRecording on failure, which calls buildMatchVideoStoragePath again with fresh Date.now() -> NEW filename. First failed upload may leave partial object at path A; retry writes path B; upsertMatchVideo UPDATE points at path B. Two orphan paths possible per session. Fix: pass storage path explicitly to retry, or skip path regeneration.
close_reason: Fixed: storage path built once per recording, reused across retries with x-upsert; compensation deferred to final attempt. Reviewed and approved.

comments.author: Drozes
comments.text: FIXED (left open for review). Root cause: the retry re-ran uploadRecording, which re-called buildMatchVideoStoragePath with a fresh Date.now(), so attempt 1's partial object stayed at path A while the retry wrote path B (double orphan). Fix: uploadRecording (apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts) accepts an optional storagePath; the hook's handleUpload builds the key ONCE per recording via buildVideoPath and passes the same value to both attempts. With jits-81l's x-upsert the retry overwrites in place. Tests: upload-recording.test.ts 'honors a caller-provided storagePath'; use-video-recorder.test.ts 'retries a failed upload with the SAME storage path' (asserts buildVideoPath called once and both calls share the path).

title: Video upload: orphan storage file when DB insert fails
description: apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts:91-106 and apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts:121-136. Storage PUT succeeds, then upsertMatchVideo throws -> file sits in bucket forever. No supabase.storage.remove() compensation. Web hook surfaces error toast (line 104) but no cleanup. BE has no documented GC. Fix: try { insert } catch { remove storage object }.
close_reason: Complete end to end on the local stack: frontend compensation (final-attempt-only remove() with Sentry observability, jits_web fde6fdb) + backend DELETE policy for the uploader's own path (jr_be ef708c7, verified via live storage-api probe: owner delete 200, opponent delete denied). Prod rollout rides jits-kaf.1.1 (db push blocked on deployment go-ahead).

comments.author: Drozes
comments.text: FIXED (left open for review). Root cause: both upload paths wrote the storage object first, then did the match_videos insert with no compensation, so a failed insert stranded the object forever. Fix: in apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts and apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts, when upsertMatchVideo returns not-ok after a successful storage write, the object is removed via supabase.storage.from('match-videos').remove([path]) (best-effort; a failed cleanup never masks the real error), then the failure is surfaced. Tests: apps/mobile/__tests__/lib/video/upload-recording.test.ts ('removes the storage object and throws when the DB upsert fails', 'failed compensation does not mask the DB error') and apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.test.ts ('removes the stored object when the DB upsert fails'). typecheck + full test suite green.

comments.author: Drozes
comments.text: Frontend half complete and reviewed: best-effort remove() compensation on final attempt only, with observable failure (error OR data.length!==1 reported to Sentry/console). BLOCKED on jr_be: no storage.objects DELETE policy exists for match-videos bucket, so compensation resolves {data:[]} (silent RLS denial) until that migration lands.

title: Mobile video upload uses POST instead of PUT; retry fails with 400
description: apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts:99 uses httpMethod='POST' for Supabase Storage. /object/<bucket>/<path> expects POST for create, PUT for upsert. x-upsert: false + POST works on first try, but retry against same path returns 400 'resource already exists'. The retry-once logic in use-video-recorder.ts:88-101 then double-fails. Web SDK .upload() handles this internally.
close_reason: Complete end to end on the local stack: frontend sends POST + x-upsert:true with the same storage path across retries (jits_web fde6fdb) + backend UPDATE policy with participant check in USING and WITH CHECK (jr_be ef708c7, verified: retry re-PUT 200 for uploader, 403 for opponent). Prod rollout rides jits-kaf.1.1.

comments.author: Drozes
comments.text: FIXED (left open for review). Root cause: FileSystem.uploadAsync sent POST with x-upsert: false, so a retry against an existing object got 400 'resource already exists'. Fix: apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts now sends x-upsert: true. Kept POST rather than switching to PUT: POST + x-upsert true is exactly what storage-js .upload(path, body, { upsert: true }) sends, and it covers both first-write and overwrite-on-retry, whereas PUT is the update-only endpoint. Combined with jits-voh's stable path, the retry now overwrites the half-written object in place. Test: upload-recording.test.ts 'POSTs to the storage REST endpoint with x-upsert: true'.

comments.author: Drozes
comments.text: Frontend half complete and reviewed: POST + x-upsert:true (storage-js wire shape), same path reused across retries. BLOCKED on jr_be: overwrite-on-retry needs a storage.objects UPDATE policy for the uploader's own match-videos path; does not exist in any migration yet.

title: Video upload: videoId lost on unmount mid-upload (orphan file)
description: apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts:151-155 and apps/mobile/lib/video/use-video-recorder.ts:162-169. Cleanup useEffect only stops media tracks; does NOT cancel in-flight upload promise. State setters fire on unmounted component (React warning + videoId lost). If upsertMatchVideo throws after storage PUT succeeded, file is orphaned in match-videos bucket with no DB row.
close_reason: Fixed: upload+DB chain runs to completion after unmount (mountedRef gates only setState); videoId durable in DB row. Reviewed and approved.

comments.author: Drozes
comments.text: FIXED (left open for review). Root cause: unmount mid-upload fired state setters on an unmounted component, and a DB failure after the storage write left an orphan (no compensation). Fix: both hooks now carry a mountedRef; the storage + DB write chain deliberately runs to completion after unmount (the upsert is NOT gated on mount), only React state setters are skipped. The orphan half is closed by jits-1v6's compensation delete; videoId is durable in the DB row regardless of unmount. Tests: mobile use-video-recorder.test.ts 'completes the upload even when unmounted mid-flight'; web use-video-recorder.test.ts 'finishes the storage + DB write even after unmounting mid-upload'.

title: Rules of Hooks violation in MatchFlowWizard
description: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/match-flow-wizard.tsx:69 calls React.useCallback AFTER conditional early returns at lines 59-64. On the render where match first arrives, hook count changes and React throws 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' Fix: move advanceToResult above the early returns. Effort: 1 line.
